title: Excel for daily drilling reports and KPIs
why: Daily drilling reports produce rich data — but turning them into KPIs and lessons learned is often done in spreadsheets.
what_is_different: Drilling KPIs depend on consistent activity codes, depth intervals and time categories (productive time vs NPT vs invisible lost time). The value is in clean categorisation and benchmarking across wells and rigs.

extra_modules.title: Time breakdown analysis
extra_modules.outcome: You can: analyse operation codes and NPT
extra_modules.practice: Build a pivot of NPT by cause and section for three wells

extra_modules.title: Cross-well benchmarking
extra_modules.outcome: You can: compare performance across wells and rigs
extra_modules.practice: Build a best-composite time curve from offset wells

starter_project: Turn a month of exported daily reports into a refreshable KPI workbook with NPT pareto, ROP by section and planned-vs-actual curves.
pitfalls: Free-text NPT descriptions that can't be analysed
Copy-paste reporting instead of refreshable queries

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
